company.name: Curans
company.shortDescription: An educational interactive platform for medical student to practice on a range of virtual patient cases.
company.description: Medical errors occur as a result of a practitioner's lack of experience or expertise, and it is this gap that led to the creation of Curans - Virtual Clinic, which aims to train doctors on virtual patients (based on real-time data) and deal with them in all aspects; as if the medical student was in his own clinic, taking the medical history, performing the tests, and so on, to provide the medical student with a detailed response about his steps and to evaluate as well as correct the physician's own incorrect procedures while treating this patient; which is equivalent to increasing doctors' expertise, self-confidence, and lowering the percentage of errors that occur as a result of treating the patient for the first time.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that allows medical students to practice clinical decision-making through interactive virtual patient cases, covering history-taking, examinations, tests, diagnosis, and treatment.
productsAndServices.name: Curans Virtual Patient Simulator

productsAndServices.description: A tool for clinical instructors to create and customize virtual patient cases to simulate authentic clinical scenarios for teaching and assessment.
productsAndServices.name: Case Editor Feature

productsAndServices.description: A functionality that presents treatment protocols step-by-step within case studies to improve understanding of clinical management.
productsAndServices.name: Presentable Cases Feature
